---
title: "Contact"
---

```{=html}
<section class="newsletter section-padding">
    <div class="container-narrow text-center">
        <h2 class="section-title">Restons en contact</h2>
        <p class="mb-5">Pour toute demande professionnelle, dédicace, ou simplement pour dire bonjour.</p>
        
        <form class="newsletter-form">
            <div class="row g-3">
                <div class="col-md-6">
                    <input type="text" placeholder="Votre Nom" required class="form-control">
                </div>
                <div class="col-md-6">
                    <input type="email" placeholder="Votre Email" required class="form-control">
                </div>
                <div class="col-12 mt-3">
                    <textarea placeholder="Votre Message" rows="5" class="form-control"></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="col-12 mt-4">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-primary w-100">Envoyer le message</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </form>
        
        <div class="social-connect mt-5">
            <h3>Suivez-moi</h3>
            <div class="social-links mt-3">
                <a href="https://instagram.com/mogadarr" target="_blank" aria-label="Instagram"><i class="bi bi-instagram"></i></a>
                <a href="https://facebook.com/mogadarr" target="_blank" aria-label="Facebook"><i class="bi bi-facebook"></i></a>
                <a href="#" target="_blank" aria-label="Threads"><i class="bi bi-threads"></i></a>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>
```
